Chapter 2

Kubernetes in a NutshellKubernetes 概览

It’s helpful to get a quick rundown of what Kubernetes is and how it works if you are new to the space. Many tutorials and 101 courses are available on the web, but I would like to summarize the most important background information and concepts in this chapter. Over the course of this book, I’ll reference cluster node components, so feel free to come back to this information at any time.

如果你刚进入这个领域，快速了解一下 Kubernetes 是什么、它如何工作会很有帮助。网上有很多教程和入门课程，但我想在本章中总结最重要的背景知识和概念。在本书后续内容中，我会反复提到集群节点的各个组件，你可以随时回到这里查阅。

What Is Kubernetes?什么是 Kubernetes？

To understand what Kubernetes is, let’s first define microservices and containers. Microservice architectures call for developing and executing pieces of the application stack as individual services, and those services have to communicate with one another. If you decide to operate those services in containers, you will need to manage a lot of them while at the same time thinking about cross-cutting concerns like scalability, security, persistence, and load balancing.

要理解 Kubernetes 是什么，我们先定义微服务和容器。微服务架构要求把应用栈拆成一个个独立的服务来开发和运行，而这些服务之间又必须相互通信。如果你决定把这些服务跑在容器里，就需要管理大量容器，同时还要考虑可扩展性、安全性、持久化和负载均衡等横切关注点。

Tools like BuildKit and Podman package software artifacts into a container image. Container runtime engines like Docker Engine and containerd use the image to run a container. This works great on developer machines for testing purposes or for ad hoc executions, e.g., as part of a continuous integration (CI) pipeline.

BuildKit、Podman 之类的工具把软件制品打包成容器镜像。Docker Engine、containerd 之类的容器运行时引擎用这个镜像来运行容器。这在开发机上做测试或临时执行时非常好用，例如作为持续集成（CI）流水线的一环。

Kubernetes is a container orchestration tool that helps with operating hundreds or even thousands of containers on physical machines, virtual machines, or in the cloud. Kubernetes can also fulfill those cross-cutting concerns mentioned earlier. The container runtime engine integrates with Kubernetes. Whenever a container creation is triggered, Kubernetes will delegate lifecycle aspects to the container runtime engine.

Kubernetes 是一个容器编排工具，帮助你在物理机、虚拟机或云上运行成百上千个容器。Kubernetes 还能实现前面提到的那些横切关注点。容器运行时引擎与 Kubernetes 集成在一起。每当触发创建容器时，Kubernetes 会把容器生命周期相关的工作委托给容器运行时引擎处理。

— PDF p.37 —

Features特性

The previous section touched on some features provided by Kubernetes. Here, I am going to dive a little deeper by explaining those features in more detail:

上一节简单提到了 Kubernetes 提供的一些特性。这里我将更深入地逐一解释：

  • Declarative model: You do not have to write imperative code using a programming language to tell Kubernetes how to operate an application. All you need to do as an end user is to declare a desired state. The desired state can be defined using a YAML or JSON manifest that conforms to an API schema. Kubernetes then maintains the state and recovers it in case of a failure.声明式模型：你不必用编程语言编写命令式代码来告诉 Kubernetes 如何运行一个应用。作为最终用户，你只需声明期望状态即可。期望状态可以用符合 API schema 的 YAML 或 JSON manifest 来定义。然后 Kubernetes 会维持该状态，并在发生故障时恢复它。
  • Autoscaling: You will want to scale up resources when your application load increases, and scale down when traffic to your application decreases. This can be achieved in Kubernetes by manual or automated scaling. The most practical, optimized option is to let Kubernetes automatically scale resources needed by a containerized application.自动扩缩容：当应用负载上升时你会想扩容资源，流量下降时又想缩容。在 Kubernetes 中这可以通过手动或自动扩缩容实现。最实用、最优的方式是让 Kubernetes 自动伸缩容器化应用所需的资源。
  • Application management: Changes to applications, e.g., new features and bug fixes, are usually baked into a container image with a new tag (likely a version number). You can easily roll out those changes across all containers running them using Kubernetes’ convenient replication feature. Kubernetes also allows for rolling back to a previous application version in case of a blocking bug or if a security vulnerability is detected.应用管理：对应用的改动（如新功能和 bug 修复）通常会被打进一个带新标签（很可能是版本号）的容器镜像。借助 Kubernetes 便捷的复制特性，你可以轻松把这些改动发布到运行该应用的所有容器上。如果出现阻断性 bug 或检测到安全漏洞，Kubernetes 还允许回滚到先前的应用版本。
  • Persistent storage: Containers offer only an ephemeral filesystem. Upon restart of the container, all data written to the filesystem is lost. Depending on the nature of your application, you may need to persist data for longer, for example, if your application interacts with a database. Kubernetes offers the ability to mount storage required by application workloads.持久化存储：容器只提供临时文件系统。容器一旦重启，写入文件系统的所有数据都会丢失。根据应用性质，你可能需要更长久地保存数据——例如当应用要与数据库交互时。Kubernetes 提供为应用工作负载挂载所需存储的能力。
  • Networking: To support a microservices architecture, the container orchestrator needs to allow for communication between containers, and from end users to containers from outside of the cluster. Kubernetes employs internal and external load balancing for routing network traffic.网络：为了支持微服务架构，容器编排器需要允许容器之间、以及集群外部的最终用户与容器之间通信。Kubernetes 使用内部和外部负载均衡来路由网络流量。

High-Level Architecture高层架构

Architecturally, a Kubernetes cluster consists of control plane nodes and worker nodes, as shown in Figure 2-1. Each node runs on infrastructure provisioned on a physical or virtual machine, or in the cloud. The number of nodes you want to add to the cluster and their topology depend on the application’s resource needs.

从架构上看，一个 Kubernetes 集群由控制平面节点和工作节点组成，如图 2-1 所示。每个节点都运行在物理机、虚拟机或云上提供的基础设施之上。你想往集群里加多少节点、采用何种拓扑，取决于应用的资源需求。

— PDF p.38 —

Control plane nodes and worker nodes have specific responsibilities:

控制平面节点和工作节点各有其特定职责：

  • Control plane node: This node exposes the Kubernetes API through the API server and manages the nodes that make up the cluster. It also responds to cluster events, for example, when the end user requests to scale up the number of Pods to distribute the load for an application. Production clusters employ a highly available (HA) architecture that usually involves three or more control plane nodes.控制平面节点：该节点通过 API server 暴露 Kubernetes API，并管理组成集群的各个节点。它还会响应集群事件——例如当最终用户请求增加 Pod 数量以分发应用负载时。生产集群采用高可用（HA）架构，通常包含三个或更多控制平面节点。
  • Worker node: The worker node executes workload in containers managed by Pods. Every worker node needs a container runtime engine installed on the host machine to be able to manage containers.工作节点：工作节点在由 Pod 管理的容器中执行业务负载。每个工作节点的宿主机上都需要安装一个容器运行时引擎，才能管理容器。
— PDF p.39 —

In the next two sections, we’ll look at the essential components embedded in those nodes to fulfill their tasks. Add-ons like cluster DNS are not discussed explicitly here. See the Kubernetes documentation for more details.

在接下来两节中，我们将看看嵌入这些节点、用以完成其任务的关键组件。像集群 DNS 这样的附加组件这里不展开讨论，详情参阅 Kubernetes 文档。

Control Plane Node Components控制平面节点组件

The control plane node requires a specific set of components to perform its job. The following list of components will give you an overview:

控制平面节点需要一组特定组件来完成工作。下面的组件清单给你一个概览：

  • API server: The API server exposes the API endpoints clients use to communicate with the Kubernetes cluster. For example, if you execute the tool kubectl, a command-line based Kubernetes client, you will make a RESTful API call to an endpoint exposed by the API server as part of its implementation. The API processing procedure inside of the API server will ensure aspects like authentication, authorization, and admission control. For more information on that topic, see Chapter 6.API server：API server 暴露客户端用来与 Kubernetes 集群通信的 API 端点。例如，当你执行 kubectl（一个基于命令行的 Kubernetes 客户端）时，实际上就是向 API server 实现中暴露的某个端点发起 RESTful API 调用。API server 内部的 API 处理流程会确保认证、授权和准入控制等环节。该主题详见第 6 章。
  • Scheduler: The scheduler is a background process that watches for new Kubernetes Pods with no assigned nodes and assigns them to a worker node for execution.Scheduler（调度器）：调度器是一个后台进程，监视尚未分配节点的新建 Kubernetes Pod，并把它们分派到某个工作节点上执行。
  • Controller manager: The controller manager watches the state of your cluster and implements changes where needed. For example, if you make a configuration change to an existing object, the controller manager will try to bring the object into the desired state.Controller manager（控制器管理器）：控制器管理器监视集群状态，并在需要时实施变更。例如，当你对某个现有对象做了配置改动，控制器管理器会努力把该对象带入期望状态。
  • etcd: Cluster state data needs to be persisted over time so it can be reconstructed upon a node restart or even a full cluster restart. That’s the responsibility of etcd, an open source software Kubernetes integrates with. At its core, etcd is a key-value store used to persist all data related to the Kubernetes cluster.etcd：集群状态数据需要持久保存，以便在节点重启甚至整个集群重启时能够重建。这正是 etcd 的职责——etcd 是 Kubernetes 集成的一个开源软件。其核心是一个键值存储，用于持久保存与 Kubernetes 集群相关的所有数据。

Common Node Components节点通用组件

Kubernetes employs components that are leveraged by all nodes independent of their specialized responsibility:

Kubernetes 还使用一些被所有节点共同依赖、与各自专项职责无关的组件：

  • Kubelet: The kubelet runs on every node in the cluster; however, it makes the most sense on a worker node. This is because the control plane node usually doesn’t execute workload, and the worker node’s primary responsibility is to run workload. The kubelet is an agent that makes sure that the necessary containers are running in a Pod. You could say that the kubelet is the glue between Kubernetes and the container runtime engine and ensures that containers are running and healthy.Kubelet：kubelet 运行在集群中的每个节点上；不过它在工作节点上才最有意义。这是因为控制平面节点通常不执行业务负载，而工作节点的首要职责就是运行负载。kubelet 是一个代理，确保 Pod 中必要的容器处于运行状态。可以说，kubelet 是 Kubernetes 与容器运行时引擎之间的粘合剂，负责保证容器正常运行且健康。
— PDF p.40 —
  • Kube-proxy: The kube-proxy is a network proxy that runs on each node in a cluster to maintain network rules and enable network communication. In part, this component is responsible for implementing the Service concept covered in Chapter 17.Kube-proxy：kube-proxy 是运行在集群每个节点上的网络代理，负责维护网络规则并实现网络通信。该组件部分地负责实现第 17 章介绍的 Service 概念。
  • Container runtime: As mentioned earlier, the container runtime is the software responsible for managing containers. The kubelet can be configured to choose from a range of different container runtime engines. While you can install a container runtime engine on a control plane, it’s not necessary, as the control plane node usually doesn’t handle workload.容器运行时：如前所述，容器运行时是负责管理容器的软件。kubelet 可以配置为从多种不同的容器运行时引擎中选择。虽然你可以在控制平面上安装容器运行时引擎，但并无必要，因为控制平面节点通常不处理业务负载。

Advantages优势

This section points out some of the most important advantages of Kubernetes, which are summarized here:

本节指出 Kubernetes 一些最重要的优势，归纳如下：

  • Portability: A container runtime engine can manage a container independent of its runtime environment. The container image bundles everything it needs to work, including the application’s binary or code, its dependencies, and its configuration. Kubernetes can run applications in a container in on-premise and cloud environments. As an administrator, you can choose the platform you think is most suitable to your needs without having to rewrite the application. Many cloud offerings provide product-specific, opt-in features. While using product-specific features helps with operational aspects, be aware that they will diminish your ability to switch easily between platforms.可移植性：容器运行时引擎可以脱离运行环境来管理容器。容器镜像把运行所需的一切都打包在内，包括应用的二进制或代码、依赖以及配置。Kubernetes 既能在本地环境、也能在云上运行容器化应用。作为管理员，你可以选择自己认为最适合需求的平台，而无需重写应用。许多云产品提供各自专属的、需主动开启的特性。使用这些专属特性虽有助于运维，但要注意：它们会削弱你在不同平台间轻松切换的能力。
  • Resilience: Kubernetes is designed as a declarative state machine. Controllers are reconciliation loops that watch the state of your cluster, then make or request changes where needed. The goal is to move the current cluster state closer to the desired state.韧性：Kubernetes 被设计为一个声明式状态机。控制器就是调和循环（reconciliation loop）：监视集群状态，然后在需要时做出或请求变更。目标是让集群的当前状态越来越接近期望状态。
  • Scalability: Enterprises run applications at scale. Just imagine how many software components retailers like Amazon, Walmart, or Target need to operate to run their businesses. Kubernetes can scale the number of Pods based on demand or automatically according to resource consumption or historical trends.可扩展性：企业大规模运行应用。想象一下 Amazon、Walmart、Target 这样的零售商为支撑业务需要运行多少软件组件。Kubernetes 可以根据需求扩缩 Pod 数量，或根据资源消耗、历史趋势自动伸缩。
  • API-based: Kubernetes exposes its functionality through APIs. We learned that every client needs to interact with the API server to manage objects. It is easy to implement a new client that can make RESTful API calls to exposed endpoints.基于 API：Kubernetes 通过 API 暴露其功能。我们已经了解到，每个客户端都需要与 API server 交互来管理对象。实现一个新客户端、向暴露的端点发起 RESTful API 调用非常容易。
— PDF p.41 —
  • Extensibility: The API aspect stretches even further. Sometimes, the core functionality of Kubernetes doesn’t fulfill your custom needs, but you can implement your own extensions to Kubernetes. With the help of specific extension points, the Kubernetes community can build custom functionality according to their requirements, e.g., monitoring or logging solutions.可扩展性：API 这一方面还能延伸得更远。有时 Kubernetes 的核心功能无法满足你的定制需求，但你可以为 Kubernetes 实现自己的扩展。借助特定的扩展点，Kubernetes 社区可以根据自身需求构建定制功能，例如监控或日志方案。

Summary本章小结

Kubernetes is software for managing containerized applications at scale. Every Kubernetes cluster consists of at least a single control plane node and a worker node. The control plane node is responsible for scheduling the workload and acts as the single entry point to manage its functionality. Worker nodes handle the workload assigned to them by the control plane node.

Kubernetes 是用于大规模管理容器化应用的软件。每个 Kubernetes 集群至少由一个控制平面节点和一个工作节点组成。控制平面节点负责调度工作负载，并作为管理集群功能的唯一入口。工作节点处理由控制平面节点分配给它们的负载。

Kubernetes is a production-ready runtime environment for companies wanting to operate microservice architectures while also supporting nonfunctional requirements like scalability, security, load balancing, and extensibility.

对于希望运行微服务架构、同时满足可扩展性、安全性、负载均衡和可扩展性等非功能性需求的公司而言，Kubernetes 是一个生产就绪的运行环境。

The next chapter will explain how to interact with a Kubernetes cluster using the command-line tool kubectl. You will learn how to run it to manage objects, an essential skill for acing the exam.

下一章将讲解如何使用命令行工具 kubectl 与 Kubernetes 集群交互。你将学习如何用它来管理对象——这是通过考试的必备技能。

— PDF p.42 —
